title: MethaneSAT first global assessment — oil & gas methane 50% higher than EDGAR/EPA estimates
snippet: MethaneSAT's first global assessment of oil and gas methane emissions: 50% higher than EDGAR estimates. Survey covers 45 oil/gas producing regions (half of world's onshore production), May 2024-June 2025 measurements. US emissions 4× higher than EPA estimates, 8× industry target. 70% from smaller dispersed sources. MethaneSAT lost contact after ~1 year in orbit but transmitted critical data trove.
tag_reason: 신규: MethaneSAT 최종 글로벌 평가 결과. 이전 보고서에 MethaneSAT 관련 항목 없음. 위성 직접 관측 데이터 기반.
